name: LogoCloud
summary: Social-proof strip of partner / customer logos. Renders 5-12 logos in a 1-row marquee or static grid. Logos render in monochrome (text.tertiary tint) by default — restoring full color on hover/focus is opt-in. Includes a sr-only label naming the partner list.

monochrome.description: Render logos in a single text-tertiary tint. False renders full-color logos.

speed.description: marquee only. Seconds per loop. Honor prefers-reduced-motion (stop the marquee).

rules: Wrapper has aria-label='Trusted by' (or the consumer's label).
Each logo is — alt MUST name the partner.
marquee layout pauses under prefers-reduced-motion AND on hover/focus (WCAG 2.2.2).
When logos are also links, each is wrapped in <a> with the company name as accessible text.

do: Render in monochrome by default — recolor on hover only if it adds meaning.
Pause marquee on hover / focus / reduce-motion.
Always include the 'Trusted by' eyebrow label so SR users hear the section.
dont: Don't use real customer logos without explicit permission.
Don't auto-play a marquee without a pause mechanism.
Don't paint the eyebrow label in lime.
